summary: Healey accepted a free 2016 trip to Israel funded by the America-Israel Friendship League and, in October 2023, posted that Massachusetts' bond with Israel rests on family ties. In July 2024 she signed budget provisions for antisemitism curricula and a commission tied to the US National Strategy; critics warned of indirect IHRA endorsement, though no explicit mandate is confirmed. The record contains no documented ceasefire call, condemnation of Israeli military action in Gaza, or opposition to US military aid to Israel.
